title: Never Lie
author: Freida McFadden
summary: A newly married couple seeks shelter from a snowstorm and finds themselves in the isolated home of a psychiatrist who has vanished. Recordings of her sessions suggest a long list of secrets.
readIf: you want a standalone, one-sitting thriller with a snowed-in setting and lots of reversals.
skipIf: you want a slow-burn mystery or dislike books that lean on shock twists.

pairings.reason: The classic isolated-location mystery, with strangers trapped together and a threat they cannot escape.
Another psychological thriller built on a woman who cannot trust what she knows.
Also centres on a psychotherapist and a secret that only unravels at the very end.
